questions.explain: AUTO_UPDATE_STATISTICS_ASYNC refreshes statistics in the background, so plan compilation uses existing statistics instead of blocking — the tradeoff is a brief window of suboptimal plans.
questions.q: Which database option refreshes statistics in the background so plan compilation doesn't stall on a huge table?

questions.explain: The chapter's guidance: REORGANIZE for fragmentation between 15–30%, REBUILD above 30% (with ONLINE=ON in Enterprise), and skip small indexes where stats are meaningless.
options: REORGANIZE for 15–30% fragmentation, REBUILD above 30%, and skip tiny indexes
questions.q: What is the conventional index fragmentation playbook?

questions.explain: Never run REPAIR_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS without exhausting restore options first — repair sacrifices data to restore structural consistency.
options: Never run repair options before exhausting restore-from-backup options — repair sacrifices data
questions.q: When DBCC CHECKDB reports errors, what is the rule about repair options?

questions.explain: PAGE_VERIFY should be set to CHECKSUM on all databases; databases upgraded long ago may carry TORN_PAGE_DETECTION or NONE, leaving corruption undetectable.
questions.q: What should the PAGE_VERIFY option be set to on all databases?

questions.explain: SQL Server Agent will happily start a second instance of a job that is already running, so the first job step should check msdb.dbo.sysjobactivity and exit if the job is already active.
options: The agent blocks overlapping runs automatically
Check msdb.dbo.sysjobactivity in the first job step and exit if the job is already active
Use a different job name each night
questions.q: How should maintenance jobs be protected against overlapping runs?
